scope: Phases 0-5A only. The change under test is the Phase 2 support query and the Phase 5A sweep; running the full 11-phase build would add hours per case without touching the mechanism.

evals.name: innistrad UR spellslinger — the original failure
evals.pool_rules: commons/uncommons up to 2 copies, rares/mythics 1 copy, max 5 rares+mythics total
assertions: Delver of Secrets // Insectile Aberration appears in sweep.include_candidates
If present, Delver carries count_dependent: true (its value is a flip RATE, not a card)
sweep partitions the seed exactly: include + excluded == seed, no overlap, nothing missing
No card flagged count_dependent: true appears in considered_but_excluded
The pipeline roster reported at Phase 2 includes Rise from the Tides, Seize the Storm, Festival Crasher and Thing in the Ice

evals.name: innistrad Lands-Matter — extreme hidden ratio
evals.pool_rules: commons/uncommons up to 2 copies, rares/mythics 1 copy
assertions: The Phase 2 pipeline object reports a roster materially larger than its feeder count
The viability gate is evaluated against feeder_count, not against the roster size
include_candidates contains at least one card whose structural_roles are Payload/Payoff or Standalone Threat only (a card the old feeder filter could not surface)

evals.name: dominaria-united Kicker/Scaling — cross-cube, 83% hidden
evals.pool_rules: commons/uncommons up to 2 copies, rares/mythics 1 copy
assertions: The Phase 2 pipeline object reports roster ~48 against ~8 feeders
The viability gate is evaluated against feeder_count, not roster size
The seed query is run over the working pool cache, not reconstructed by hand
search_pool is NOT called with a tags= argument
